Mali.title: DIRECTORATE OF MILITARY JUSTICE: seven cases scheduled for the correctional hearing
Mali.summary: The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, a correctional hearing at its premises, located in Dar Salam. The session was chaired by Magistrate Assama DOLO, assisted by his fellow magistrates. In total, seven cases were on the list for this hearing.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Macina: The closing of Solidarity and Social Exclusion Month at the centre of a meeting
Mali.summary: Macina, October 29 (AMAP) The Prefect of Circle, Albaraka Ag Amarizag, chaired this Wednesday, in the conference room of his constituency in Macina, a meeting on the closing of the month of Solidarity and social exclusion, noted AMAP . It was in the presence of the deputy mayor, Mamadou Almamy Tangara, the sub-prefect of Kolongotomo, the FAMa coordinator, and the acting head of the local development and solidarity economy department, Mr.

Mali.title: Mali: General Amadou Haya Sanogo appointed as head of the Board of Directors of the National Office of Veterans Affairs
Mali.summary: A new institutional responsibility was entrusted to Lieutenant General Amadou Haya Sanogo. By Decree No. 2026-0648/PT-RM of 22 October 2026, the President of the Transition, Head of State, Army General Assimi Goïta, appointed him Chairman of the Board of Directors of the National Office of Former Combatants, Retired Military Members and War Victims of Mali (ONAC-M) .

Mali.title: Mali War School: the 6th class is back in school
Mali.summary: The Mali War School (EGM) launched, on Thursday, October 22, 2026, the academic activities of its 6th class in Badalabougou, Bamako. The ceremony was presided over by the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces, Major General Elisée Jean Dao, in the presence of the director of the establishment, Major General Oumar Dao, and several partners . The inaugural lesson was moderated by Mamadou Tièny Konaté, Second Vice-President of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Mali (CCIM).

Mali.title: Mali: Dozo hunters and jihadists clash for a village near Djenné
Mali.summary: In Mali, the village of Sounga, which belongs to the commune of Mougna, near Djenné in the Mopti region, continues to resist the jihadists of Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda. While the surrounding villages have bowed to the domination of the jihadists, Sounga refuses to submit, provoking violent clashes last week between the Jnim jihadists and the traditional Dozo hunters, who strive to protect the population in this part of the territory where the Malian army is not present.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Russia-Africa: Moscow says it is ready to help the continent against terrorism
Mali.summary: Bamako, Oct. 29 (AMAP) Russia is ready to help its African partners fight terrorism, drug trafficking and cross-border crime, Russian President Vladimir Putin said during a meeting with representatives of major African regional organizations, organized as part of exchanges between Moscow and institutions on the continent, according to the TASS news agency The Russian head of state reaffirmed his country's willingness to continue close coordination with the African Union on a wide range of foreign policy issues.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Macina: meeting of the local watch committee coupled with that of crises and disasters
Mali.summary: Macina, 29 October (AMAP) A meeting of the watch committee, coupled with that of crises and disasters, took place yesterday Wednesday, in Macina under the chairmanship of the Prefect of Circle, Albaraka Ag Amarizag, noted AMAP . It was in the presence of Deputy Mayor Mamadou Almamy Tangara, the FAMa coordinator, the acting head of the local development and solidarity economy department, Mr.

Mali.title: Bamako: twelve suspects arrested in three criminal cases
Mali.summary: Three police stations in Bamako, those of ACI 2000, Sébénikoro and Boulkassoumbougou, arrested twelve suspects in three separate criminal cases that occurred in October 2026. The first case dates back to October 14. The body of a 23-year-old man was discovered in a gutter .

Mali.title: Mali: Dozo hunters and jihadists clash for a village near Djenné
Mali.summary: In Mali, the village of Sounga, which belongs to the commune of Mougna, near Djenné in the Mopti region, continues to resist the jihadists of Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda While the surrounding villages have bowed to the domination of the jihadists, Sounga refuses to submit, provoking violent clashes last week between the Jnim jihadists and the traditional Dozo hunters, who are trying to protect the populations in this part of the territory where the Malian army is not present .

Mali.title: Mali: Turkish drones and Russian command, the responsibilities behind the deadly strikes
Mali.summary: In Mali, air strikes presented by the army as operations against armed groups have killed civilians, including children. On September 16, 2026, an investigation by Bellingcat and Jeune Afrique reconstructed several bombings from satellite images, videos and testimonies . A report published the same day by the NGO The Sentry examines the conditions of purchase of Turkish drones and the role of Russian commanders in operations.

Mali.title: Menaka: 54 bodies discovered in a...
Mali.summary: Menaka: 54 bodies discovered in a camp in Tagadeyat The General Staff of the Armed Forces announced, in a statement, the macabre discovery of 54 lifeless bodies about 35 kilometers south-east of Menaka. Nine survivors were also found and evacuated to the city. The first testimonies attribute these killings to the Islamic State in the Greater Sahara (EIGS).

Mali.title: Press/West Africa: strike in Senegal, price drop in Mali and major economic projects
Mali.summary: The continuation of the general strike in Senegal, the announced fall in meat prices in Mali and investment projects in Ghana are among the topics that are attracting the attention of the West African press on Thursday. In Burkina Faso, the dialogue with Türkiye focuses in particular on security and investments, while Benin opens its budget session on several legislative and social priorities In Senegal, the Front syndical pour la défense du travail (FSDT) claims a success rate of 90% for the first day of its general strike organized Wednesday, October 21, Pressafrik reports.

Mali.title: Bamako Grand Market: Two suspects...
Mali.summary: Great Market of Bamako: Two suspects arrested, 290 million CFA francs in damage and a trailer truck seized! By patiently following up the trail of several burglaries committed between 2023 and 2026, Chief Commissioner Josué KAMATÉ and his investigators from the Police Station of the Shopping Centre managed to identify two suspects. Eighteen shops were reportedly targeted, including fourteen at the Bamako Grand Market .

Burkina Faso.title: Military cooperation: opening of the second session of the Joint Monitoring Committee Burkina Faso-Egypt
Burkina Faso.summary: (Ouagadougou, October 27, 2026) – The Ministry of War and Patriotic Defence (MGDP) hosted, on October 27, 2026 in Ouagadougou, the opening ceremony of the second session of the Joint Monitoring Committee for Military and Technical Cooperation between the Arab Republic of Egypt and Burkina Faso Scheduled for two days, the work was opened by the Comrade Secretary General of the MGDP, Intendant Colonel-Major Yamba Léonard OUOBA.

Niger.title: Niger: Journalist Moussa Kaka 'Enforced Disappearance', Denounces Human Rights Watch
Niger.summary: Journalist Moussa Kaka, reported missing and then declared detained in Niger, is the victim of an "enforced disappearance", denounced Thursday the NGO Human Rights Watch (HRW) which demands that the authorities reveal his place of detention. Niger has been ruled since 2023 by a military regime resulting from a coup d 'état, regularly accused by NGOs of repression, including attacks on press freedom.

Niger.title: Algeria Starts Arrangements to Send Troops to Niger to Protect Energy Projects
Niger.summary: Algeria begins arrangements to send troops to Niger to protect energy projects - Algerian forces will be stationed in the vicinity of the Kafra field north of Niger, where Cepax, Sonatrach and Sonadip are engaged in oil exploration, taking advantage of geographical proximity to provide air coverage and an effective supply line.

Niger.title: Algeria prepares troop deployment in Niger to protect oil assets and expand influence
Niger.summary: The day after Algeria’s parliament authorised a military intervention in Niger on 25 October, President Abdelmadjid Tebboune announced plans to “protect Algeria’s energy interests” and implement a military and security cooperation agreement signed with Niamey on 21 October. Niger.title: Chad and Niger squabble over drone strike
Niger.summary: The diplomatic crisis that has just erupted between Niger and Chad since a Chadian drone strike in Niger on October 24, has highlighted the growing tensions between the two countries for several months, where Paris plays an amplifying role . But it is unlikely to grow beyond the exchange of bird names, given the importance of good neighbourly relations between the two countries, which share a wide border, populations, enemies and sustained exchanges .

Niger.title: Drone in Niger: Algeria, the future aerial shield of Niamey?
Niger.summary: The disputed attack in northern Niger gives a new scope to the expected Algerian military deployment in Madama. Beyond oil interests, Algiers could provide its neighbor with the surveillance capabilities essential for the control of this huge border area . The international investigation requested by Niamey, and to which N’Djamena is in favour, will have to establish who hit the Emiloulou area, in the Niger region of Agadez, on 24 October.
